title: KindergartenMmrCoverage
description:
Kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage for a geography and school year.
A missing value is represented by the absence of a row (or a null exemption), never by 0.

coverage_pct.description: Percent of kindergartners with the MMR series, 0 to 100.

exemption_pct.description: Percent with any exemption, 0 to 100; `null` when the source does not report it.

imputation_method.description: Non-empty description of the imputation method when `imputed`; `null` otherwise.

imputed.description: True when `coverage_pct` was filled in by a method rather than measured. Always flagged.

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded

Provenance.description: Where a number came from: the immutable snapshot, its source URL and when it was retrieved.

licence_id.description: Id of the source's licence or terms as listed in `SOURCES.md`.

sha256.description: Content address of the raw snapshot bytes.

source_id.description: Stable id of the source as listed in `SOURCES.md` (e.g. `cdc-measles-weekly`).

url.description: URL the snapshot was retrieved from.

SchoolYear.description: School year, e.g. 2023-24 (second part is the next year mod 100)
